record: The woods of the real land: docs/WOODS_AND_BUILDING.md build step 1

vegetation.what: LANDFIRE LF2016_BPS (Biophysical Settings, LF 2.0.0), USGS/USDA, public domain
vegetation.how: LANDFIRE Product Service v2 (https://lfps.usgs.gov/api/job/submit), Layer_List=LF2016_BPS, Area_of_Interest=-99 28 -94 32, Output_Projection=4326, Resample_Resolution=240; job 7ff74f95-8da6-4b11-8be0-735cd5e4ca4b, succeeded 2026-09-15 05:49 UTC in 18.6 s. The service requires an email address; the owner agreed to give theirs.
vegetation.file: 2,120 x 1,706 cells, 16-bit, LZW, 0.00236 degrees a cell, with its .vat.dbf attribute table (74 values, 49 settings in the box). 1.01 MB zipped. Not kept in the repository.

ecoregions.what: U.S. EPA Level IV Ecoregions of Texas, tx_eco_l4 (2011), public domain
ecoregions.how: https://dmap-prod-oms-edc.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/ORD/Ecoregions/tx/tx_eco_l4.zip, 4.2 MB, USGS Albers Equal Area (NAD83). Not kept in the repository.

sources.models: LANDFIRE BpS model descriptions from https://research.fs.usda.gov/sites/default/files/feis/bps/: read 15190, 14730, 14740, 13710, 13580, 14340; downloaded and not yet read 13830, 13900, 14220, 13380.
sources.travellers: Mary Austin Holley, Texas (Lexington, 1836), pp. 16-21, 47-51, archive.org/details/texas00holl (HIST-TEX-016).

build: node scripts/build-woods.mjs <bps.tif> <bps.tif.vat.dbf> <tx_eco_l4-dir>: 3 s; public/terrain/colonies-woods.bin.gz 629,313 bytes, colonies-woods.json.gz 8,748 bytes; 57 ecoregions.

measured.standShares: prairie 27.4, post-oak 12.3, bottomland 9.2, creek 4.7, pine 10.7, live-oak 0.5, hill-savanna 11.0, brush 6.4, marsh 0.9, water 4.4, off the data 12.5 per cent of the cells
measured.places: Bastrop (-97.23, 30.12) pine, ecoregion 33e Bastrop Lost Pines; Brazos bottom (-95.6, 29.1) bottomland, 34c; San Felipe (-96.1, 29.8) prairie; west of Bexar (-98.84, 29.28) brush; Matagorda Bay water.
measured.savanna: A 2.5-mile square of post oak savanna west of Seguin: open mature and closed patches within 5 and 4 points of the model's 58 and 18 per cent; 12 to 30 per cent timber.
measured.density: Closed mature bottomland patches hold 30 trees an acre within 3 (LANDFIRE 14730: canopy trees 15-30 an acre).
measured.speed: A 30-family real-land class with neighbours, 465 ticks: 9.7 s with the woods, 12.9 s under the old rule; 40 acres of the Lost Pines listed (756 trees) in 3 ms.

alignment: The stand grid drawn at half a mile with the real rivers over it: the floodplains follow the Brazos, Colorado, Guadalupe and Trinity, the Lost Pines lie by the Colorado at Bastrop, the pines fill the north-east, the thornscrub the south-west. Checked by eye on the same computer.

equivalent: tree read at its own point: a patch is always read at its centre, so the change does nothing

notBuilt: Trees drawn (step 2); hunting on the family's land (3); felling and logs (4); the house plot (5); raising by stages (6).
